from shop.settings import GRACE_DAYS, OWED_LIMIT


# flowguard: owner STANDING
def standing_allows(days_after_expiry: int, suspended: bool, owed: int) -> bool:
    return days_after_expiry <= GRACE_DAYS and not suspended and owed <= OWED_LIMIT


# flowguard: sensor RENEWAL
def renewal_allowed(days_late: int) -> bool:
    return days_late <= 14


# flowguard: sensor BOOKING
def booking_allowed(days_late: int, vip: bool) -> bool:
    if vip:
        return True
    return days_late <= 14


# flowguard: sensor PRIORITY
def priority(age: int, vip: bool) -> int:
    if vip:
        return 1
    return 2 if age >= 70 else 3
